flashcards.back: C++ is a high-performance, compiled, general-purpose programming language.
C++ was created by Bjarne Stroustrup.

flashcards.front: What is the main use of C++?
flashcards.back: The main use of C++ is for building operating systems, games, and other high-performance applications.
Yes, C++ is an object-oriented language that supports the principles of encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism.

flashcards.front: What is the difference between C and C++?
flashcards.back: C++ is an extension of the C language and adds features such as object-oriented programming, templates, and exception handling.
